methods.existing_baseline: Preserve provided BLS source chunks; split Fed and Thai PBS text into contiguous 1200-character chunks without overlap.
methods.recursive_fixed: Deterministic 1200-character splitting with 180-character overlap and whitespace boundaries.
methods.structure_aware: Preserve BLS heading sections; paragraph-group Fed and Thai PBS text to 1800 characters.
methods.semantic: Deterministic sentence/paragraph grouping; this is a text-boundary heuristic, not model-based semantic chunking.
methods.adaptive: Paragraph-aware grouping with a per-document target of 1600, 1200, or 900 characters.
